label: War Host
description: Massed armies read as one visual body — formation, materials and the light on them. The crowd layer of battle scenes; tags couple with genre.

items.name: shield-wall
items.text: an interlocked shield-wall three ranks deep, round limewood shields overlapping like fish scales, spearpoints bristling over the painted rims, breath steaming through the eye-gaps

items.name: cavalry-wedge
items.text: a heavy cavalry wedge at full commit, caparisoned destriers packed shoulder to shoulder, couched lances dropping level in a rolling wave, clods of turf hanging in the air behind the hooves

items.name: pike-square
items.text: a pike square holding fast, sixteen-foot ash shafts staggered at three heights, the hedge of points swaying together like wind moving through a steel wheatfield

items.name: longbow-line
items.text: a longbow line loosing at full draw, a thousand shafts climbing in one dark sheet, the next flight already nocked, waxed strings and leather bracers catching the light

items.name: knight-vanguard
items.text: a vanguard of dismounted knights advancing at a walk, full plate mud-caked to the knee, visors down, poleaxes carried at port — an iron tide that does not hurry

items.name: tusked-horde
items.text: a tusked war-horde loping across the field in loose packs, crude iron plates lashed over scarred hides, ragged totems shaking overhead, drummers driving the pace

items.name: undead-legion
items.text: an undead legion advancing in absolute silence, verdigris armor buckled over bare bone, rank after rank emerging from ground-mist with rusted spears all at the same angle

items.name: elven-host
items.text: an elven host moving like water flowing uphill, mirror-bright mail under grey travel cloaks, leaf-bladed spears rising and falling in step with no drumbeat to follow

items.name: dwarven-shield-fort
items.text: a dwarven shield-fort grinding forward step by counted step, tower shields locked into a moving wall, war-hammers hooked over the rims, deep voices keeping the cadence

items.name: siege-column
items.text: an assault column surging toward the breach under raised ladders and hide-covered mantlets, a battering ram swinging in its cradle, spent arrows standing thick in the timber

items.name: levy-muster
items.text: a peasant levy massed behind a row of sharpened stakes, billhooks and scythes held above patched gambesons, set faces under borrowed helmets

items.name: griffin-wing
items.text: a wing of griffin-riders stooping out of the cloud deck in echelon, lance pennons snapping, the shadows of their dive racing across the field below them
